description: This file is a shell script containing tests for verifying the proper updating and rewriting of a cache-tree feature in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for generating and comparing cache trees, along with various test cases that validate cache-tree consistency across different Git operations.

methods.name: cmp_cache_tree
methods.description: Compares the current cache tree output to an expected output file, filtering out reference hashes and normalizing SHA values.

methods.name: generate_expected_cache_tree
methods.description: Recursively generates the expected cache tree structure for a given directory path, listing files and subtrees.
